dialogues.speaker: Sekkura
dialogues.text: Dusk birds are usually used to carry messages. They're essential for my job as a Swallow Messenger.

dialogues.speaker: Sekkura
dialogues.text: While they've cut down on the need for me to run errands, I now spend a lot more time in town.

dialogues.speaker: Sekkura
dialogues.text: My home is Aaru Village, which is a small settlement on the desert edge.

dialogues.speaker: Sekkura
dialogues.text: How I long to visit Aaru Village again... It feels like an eternity since I saw Candace. We've got a lot to catch up on.

dialogues.speaker: Sekkura
dialogues.text: Such as life in the city, stories about the rainforest, and Parchamdar Rukh Shah...
